name: Apollon ImGui
author: Apollon / ZEFF · reborn
description: Apollon for MC Bedrock 1.26.66.1 (arm64-v8a). Fixes from first working test: (1) features were gated on inMenu, which is permanently true because ClientInstanceOnTick is 0 in the 1.26 table -> every hex patch was restored forever, so only the inline-hooked features could ever act; (2) the speed hooks had no module gate and ran with the module off; (3) speed modules now have explicit toggles. SpeedHack/Water/Lava act only when enabled AND multiplier>1.
